# Sam Gilson

> Sam Gilson is a computer science education researcher interested in how undergraduates use generative AI to learn: in writing proofs, in discrete mathematics, and in game AI.

Sam Gilson, PhD student in computer science in the Game2Learn lab at North Carolina State University, advised by Dr. Tiffany Barnes.

ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0002-2394-8649

## Concepts

- [One-Shot GenAI Resistance](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/one-shot-genai-resistance/): One-Shot GenAI Resistance is a property of an assignment question: a target chatbot scores below 60% on it across three separate attempts with the same prompt.
  Also written: One-Shot Generative AI Resistance, One-Shot GenAI-Resistant, One-Shot GenAI Resistant, AI-resistant assignment
- [iterative perturbation process](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/iterative-perturbation-process/): The iterative perturbation process is an eight-step, instructor-led loop that rewrites an assignment question until a target chatbot fails it three times running.
  Also written: Adversarial Iterative Perturbation, Adversarial Assignment Perturbation, iterative perturbation method
- [Spatial Injection](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/spatial-injection/): Spatial Injection is a perturbation strategy that adds reasoning requiring visual or geometric interpretation to a question, so a model must track layout as well as arithmetic.
  Also written: spatial constraint
- [Axiomatic Replacement](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/axiomatic-replacement/): Axiomatic Replacement is a perturbation strategy that alters a question's fundamental logical premises or axioms to prevent a model retrieving a memorised proof.
  Also written: axiom replacement
- [Contextual Embedding](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/contextual-embedding/): Contextual Embedding is a perturbation strategy that places a question inside unfamiliar, class-specific context which the grading rubric then requires the answer to use.
  Also written: contextual embedding strategy
- [Three-Attempt Consistency Protocol](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/three-attempt-consistency-protocol/): The Three-Attempt Consistency Protocol re-prompts a model with the exact query two further times, and classifies a question resistant only if all three attempts fail.
  Also written: three-attempt protocol, result validity check
- [Cognitive Scaffolding](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/cognitive-scaffolding/): Cognitive Scaffolding is an engagement pattern in which a student recognises that a chatbot has hallucinated and supplies context to steer it toward a correct answer.
  Also written: cognitive scaffolding strategy, collaborative repair
- [GenAI dependence](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/genai-dependence/): GenAI dependence is an engagement pattern in which a student accepts a chatbot's hallucinated answer without critically evaluating it.
  Also written: Dependency, Dependence, cognitive outsourcing
- [online, on-demand CS coursework](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/online-on-demand-cs-coursework/): Online, on-demand CS coursework is computing coursework a student takes outside a degree programme, on their own schedule, to supplement that programme.
  Also written: OOD CS coursework, OODCS, on-demand computer science coursework
- [DRIVE framework](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/drive-framework/): The DRIVE framework is a taxonomy for generative AI interactions that separates how a student steers an exchange from how they articulate what they know.
  Also written: Deep Reasoning in Virtual Education, DRIVE taxonomy

## Tools and games

- [Perturbation Workbench](https://sgilson7.github.io/projects/perturbation-workbench/): Run the AIED 2026 iterative perturbation protocol in the browser. Nothing is uploaded. (Research tool)
- [PDF Redactor](https://sgilson7.github.io/projects/pdf-redactor/): Redact student names and strip all metadata from PDFs, entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded. (Research tool)
- [Gear Master](https://sgilson7.github.io/projects/gear-master/): Build gear out of parts, then watch your character auto-battle. Rust + macroquad. (Game)
- [Gear Master 2D](https://sgilson7.github.io/projects/gear-master-2d/): A 2D tile-based open-world RPG on the gear-assembly auto-battler from gear-master. (Game)
- [Floodline](https://sgilson7.github.io/projects/floodline/): Multiplayer medieval city builder in the browser. Deterministic lockstep over WebRTC; every age ends in a flood. (Game)
